comment: The meshing domain (EPSG:4326) is closure_before + the open boundary + closure_after. The SW crossing follows the open boundary, extended into Miura land at its NW end; the southern closure runs east at lat 34.973 to the Boso coast, an artificial land line as in goto2023. closure_size_probe: where the coast size at the end of the southern closure is read, for the open-boundary corridor.
